Thresherium is a static, self-guided tool for artists, made by Sinaida Krivchenko. It runs entirely in the visitor's browser as plain HTML, CSS and ES modules, with no build step, no framework and no external requests. It is available in English only. It has no accounts and no analytics, sets no cookies for tracking and collects no data: the only thing it may store is one line recording a storage choice, in the visitor's own browser. Privacy details: https://sinaida-space.github.io/thresherium/#/privacy
